id./param/scenario/cs/a_150_cs_040.pack|cs_: "Look, look! Auntie's here! The show's about to begin!
"Are you all paying attention? Good. Then I'll tell you the tale of the terrible curse that befell our village long ago.
"The curse of a crafty creature with a face as pretty as a pearl, but a heart as black as coal. Now, let's begin...
"Once upon a time, a master fisherman lived in Lonalulu. He caught more fish and gathered more pearls than any other man.
"The Big Kahuna was very fond of this fisherman, and offered him the hand of his beloved daughter.
"The fisherman and the Kahuna's daughter agreed to be married, and the village's future looked bright.
"Until the day of the storm... The fisherman was caught in a terrible tempest and thrown into the ocean with his catch...
"As he sank, he saw the pearls he had gathered shining like stars. The light faded, and he prepared to meet his maker...
"But instead, he met her: a mermaid more beautiful than any creature he had seen. She whispered in his ear...
'I will give you your life if you give me your soul...'
"Many days passed, and the fisherman did not return. The village thought him dead and held a funeral on the beach.
"But just as they began to sing his soul into the next world, he appeared, exhausted but alive!
"The Kahuna's daughter was overjoyed and nursed him back to health. But...
"The fisherman was no longer the man she knew. All day he stared out to sea, muttering, 'I must marry that mermaid'...
"Then one day he threw his fiancée aside and ran to the harbour, screaming 'I must go back to her!' The Kahuna was furious.
"He banished the fisherman from the village and burned his boat so he could never set sail again.
"And so the pride of Lonalulu spent his days alone on Saikiki Beach, haunted by the mermaid who stole his soul...
"That's all for today, children. I'll tell you the rest tomorrow.
"Mermaids are scary... Waaah! The mermaid's coming to steal our souls! Ruuun!
"Aloha, friends. Is there anything I can do for you?
"Maybe! We're looking for a fisherman called Kai. Do you know where we can find him?
"Oh my, what a coincidence! You must be looking for my son, Kainui. Are you friends of his?
"I'm afraid he's not here. All the men sailed west to fight the giant squid that's been attacking our ships.
"If you want to hurry things along, maybe you could lend a hand? Once it's dealt with, they'll all come back.
"But be wary, friends. That squid isn't the only danger out on the seas. Don't let a crafty mermaid make you pupule!
